breaking_news.headline: Is Patagonia the new data center hub? + Harley-Davidson's role in the trade war
breaking_news.summary: Why Patagonia might become a new data center hub

breaking_news.headline: Amid war and sanctions, many Iranians are losing their jobs and struggling to get by
breaking_news.summary: Many Iranians lost their jobs because of the war and the U.S. blockade. Now some are even losing their backup jobs as sanctions tighten.

breaking_news.headline: Anthropic and OpenAI CEOs call for AI development to slow down, OpenAI to delay IPO
breaking_news.summary: Dario Amodei and Sam Altman are the latest to urge caution amid fears the industry is racing too fast to build powerful AI while safety measures lag.

breaking_news.headline: A new tax incentive could lead to more films being made in the U.S. rather than abroad
breaking_news.summary: President Trump and Congress are weighing in on potential federal tax incentives for film production. It's hoped the tax credit would keep production of films and TV in the U.S. rather than overseas.

breaking_news.headline: The powerful millionaires hiding in plain sight
breaking_news.summary: They own car dealerships, law firms, dental practices, and restaurant chains. Collectively, these overlooked business owners hold far more wealth than the Forbes 400 — and wield considerable political power.

breaking_news.headline: Get ready for yet another cost when buying a home: Junk fees
breaking_news.summary: Some real estate agents and researchers say home buyers and sellers should not pay this out-of-pocket fee.

breaking_news.headline: This  bill could reshape crypto in America -- and it's sparking a major battle
breaking_news.summary: The legislation would establish rules of the road for the crypto sector for the first time — but opponents are up in arms, and the bill faces an uncertain prospect in the Senate.

breaking_news.headline: Family income rose and poverty fell in 2025 — but safety net cuts could erase gains
breaking_news.summary: An annual report from the Census Bureau shows the average family made more money in 2025 than the year before, while the official poverty rate declined. Health care coverage was little changed from 2024.

breaking_news.headline: Nigeria arrests alleged Mexican drug kingpin at international airport
breaking_news.summary: Arturo Carrera Loaiza denies allegations he was involved in meth production, the Nigerian authorities say.

breaking_news.headline: Canada is a 'safe harbour' for global finance, Carney says
breaking_news.summary: The prime minister is hosting a major global investment summit, with the goal of attracting money into the country amid a trade war with the US.

breaking_news.headline: Iran war has led to US munitions shortfalls, Pentagon inspector confirms
breaking_news.summary: The inspector also found a bottleneck in resupply, despite President Donald Trump's claims that US supplies are "virtually limitless".

breaking_news.headline: Two sailors missing after tanker attacked in Strait of Hormuz, Oman says
breaking_news.summary: Iran says El Gaia caught fire after hitting mines, but the US says the oil tanker was struck by a missile and then a drone.

breaking_news.headline: South African president vows justice as more women's bodies found near Johannesburg
breaking_news.summary: Police have not linked the deaths to a serial killer but are investigating this possibility.

breaking_news.headline: Suspected sabotage causes major Netherlands rail disruption
breaking_news.summary: Trains were cancelled or delayed on Tuesday after objects were found on tracks at multiple locations.

breaking_news.headline: What weapon could the US have put into space?
breaking_news.summary: The announcement by the US points to a developing field of modern warfare in the Earth's orbit.

breaking_news.headline: Denmark says Russian warship fired flares at military helicopter
breaking_news.summary: The Danish prime minister has accused Russia of "reckless" behaviour, while the Kremlin is yet to comment.

breaking_news.headline: Government set to nationalise troubled steel firm
breaking_news.summary: Production at SSUK sites in South Yorkshire and the West Midlands was paused earlier this year.

breaking_news.headline: AI regulation faces political deadlock as calls grow for Congress to act
breaking_news.summary: With Trump opposed and Congress divided, new safety legislation on AI is unlikely to pass anytime soon despite mounting pressure.

breaking_news.headline: Pubs in England and Wales to allow digital ID apps to prove age
breaking_news.summary: New rules introduced on Tuesday mean establishments will be able to accept digital ID apps alongside physical documents.

breaking_news.headline: AI 'kill switch' may need to be mandatory, Anthropic co-founder tells BBC
breaking_news.summary: US President Donald Trump dismisses calls to slow the development of AI, saying that claims of it "taking over the World" are a "HOAX".
